entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: A metal plane whose Mirran civilization is built on the fusion of flesh with metal and is about to meet Phyrexia.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: A civilization founded on the fusion of flesh with metal, an empire of many kinds of creatures from a common origin, also claiming Mirrodin.

entities.name: Mirrans
entities.description: The civilization of Mirrodin, opposed to Phyrexia in the coming conflict.

entities.name: Ish Sah
entities.description: A Mirran/Phyrexian term distinguished from the Kha in the glossary.

entities.name: Kha
entities.description: A term from the Mirran and Phyrexian glossary.

entities.name: Auriok
entities.description: A Mirran people distinguished from the Moriok in the glossary.

entities.name: Moriok
entities.description: A people distinguished from the Auriok in the glossary.

events.summary: The Mirran and Phyrexian civilizations are on the brink of discovering one another.
events.quote: Two entire civilizations, Mirrodin and Phyrexia, are on the brink of discovering one another.

relations.note: The two sides are headed for brutal conflict.
